what: Hovering a list row with a dotted underline: the dotted line folds away pivoting on its right end, and in the same spot a solid line unfolds from the left end (.3s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1)). On release the solid line folds back to the left and the dotted line extends again from the left — quietly signaling that news rows and admissions-guide rows are clickable.

options.--fx-line: Line color (css variable), default var(--kf-accent) — original is yellow (the color turned from the accent)
options.--fx-bottom: Distance to lift the line off the bottom (css variable), default 0px
options.--fx-dur: Fold and unfold duration (css variable), default .3s
options.--fx-ease: Curve (css variable), default cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1) — STUDIO default

use: Application guide · Admissions schedule
note: Lines are drawn with the element’s ::before (dotted) and ::after (solid) — if the element already has other ::before · ::after, attach them to a wrapping element. The line width is supplied by the user

from.where: index.html notice row·admissions guide row·international student row, event.html schedule row (original div[aria-label=border-dashed]·[aria-label=border-solid] two layers — STUDIO default .3s cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1), yellow 1px)
